sources.text: Boas-vindas ao Próxima Semana em XBOX! Neste post semanal, cobrimos todos os jogos que chegarão em breve ao XBOX Series X|S, XBOX One, XBOX no PC e XBOX Game Pass! Confira abaixo mais detalhes sobre esses próximos jogos e clique em seus perfis para mais informações (datas de lançamento sujeitas a alteração). Vamos começar! 10 de novembro – Game Pass / Entrega Inteligente / XBOX Play Anywhere Suba na sua Bike e entregue cartas e encomendas aos peculiares habitantes da ilha japonesa fictícia de TANUKI. As encomendas variam em tamanho, peso e formato, então cabe a você planejar a melhor maneira de fazer cada entrega. À medida que você fortalece os laços de amizade e conquista a confiança dos moradores, eles pedirão sua ajuda em diversas atividades. Participe para desbloquear itens e recompensas que ajudarão na restauração do santuário. 10 de novembro – Game Pass / XBOX Play Anywhere Warhammer Survivors é um roguelite de sobrevivência com ritmo acelerado que coloca um elenco de personagens icônicos de Warhammer para enfrentar hordas intermináveis de inimigos de diversas facções da franquia. Desenvolvido pela Auroch Digital ( Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun ) em parceria com Warhammer e poncle ( Vampire Survivors ), o jogo convida você a descobrir os universos de “Warhammer 40,000” e “Warhammer: Age of Sigmar” em toda a sua glória em pixel art nesta nova maratona de sobrevivência. 11 de novembro – Game Pass / XBOX Play Anywhere Seus esboços podem ser as únicas pistas que você tem. Jogue como Hope Song, de 17 anos, neste mistério narrativo ambientado em Shenyang, na China. Enquanto todos ao seu redor sucumbem à pressão das provas, Hope encontra refúgio em seus desenhos, até que seus pais desaparecem. Investigue o que aconteceu, conecte as pistas e descubra a verdade escondida sob a aparente tranquilidade da cidade. Transforme sua cidade no mais poderoso de todos os reinos com combinações infinitas de construções, unidades, feitiços e posicionamento. Expanda seu reino de forma estratégica, prepare-se para dezenas de eventos únicos e mostre ao mundo que seu reino pode resistir por mais tempo que todos os outros, tanto no modo solo quanto no multijogador assíncrono. Este jogo está em desenvolvimento. Ele pode ou não passar por mudanças ao longo do tempo ou ser lançado como um produto final. Compre apenas se você estiver confortável com o estado atual do jogo inacabado. Deixe-se envolver por uma atmosfera aconchegante em que cada pequena ação e cada detalhe importam. Hozy é um convite para desacelerar. Não há cronômetros, pontuações, penalidades e muito menos estresse ou pressão. Só você, suas ferramentas e a simples alegria de deixar os espaços bonitos de novo. Seja limpando janelas, pintando paredes ou encontrando o lugar perfeito para um sofá, tudo foi pensado para que você aproveite cada tarefa com tranquilidade e satisfação. Embarque em uma aventura tropical de quebra-cabeças em Captain Coco: Treasure Island ! Junte-se ao Capitão Coco, um macaco pirata esperto com a missão de abrir baús de tesouro empurrando cocos pelas fases de uma ilha misteriosa. Mas não se deixe enganar pelas praias ensolaradas e florestas exuberantes! Cada fase é um desafio de raciocínio que exige planejamento cuidadoso, movimentos inteligentes e um pouco de engenhosidade pirata. Hard West 2 é uma jornada ao coração das trevas do Velho Oeste americano. Assuma o controle de um bando sobrenatural e alcance o misterioso Trem Fantasma. Supere seus inimigos na estratégia, na trapaça e no poder de fogo neste jogo de tática em turnos ambientado em um Velho Oeste onde nada é o que parece. Comece uma nova vida em uma fazenda tomada pela vegetação na tranquila cidade rural de Clover Town. Desta vez, você não está só: crie adoráveis companheiros gelatinosos que ajudam você a cuidar da fazenda, explorar e fazer novas amizades. Ova Magica combina simulação de vida na fazenda com a jogabilidade de um JRPG de coleção de criaturas para oferecer uma experiência aconchegante e cheia de aventuras. RACCOIN: Chaos Max Edition combina a diversão caótica das clássicas máquinas de empurrar moedas dos fliperamas com a construção de baralhos de um roguelike. Combine moedas especiais com itens poderosos para ativar sinergias satisfatórias. É uma descarga de dopamina sem fim em uma experiência imprevisível em que as moedas não param de cair. Explore o reino de contos de fadas de Tão Tão Distante, do pântano de Shrek ao castelo de Fiona e todos os lugares pelo caminho, em uma experiência clássica de ação e aventura inspirada no filme da DreamWorks Animation. Jogue solo ou com até três amigos no modo cooperativo e assuma o controle dos seus heróis favoritos de Shrek para enfrentar personagens icônicos da franquia com golpes, arremessos e chutes. Embarque em uma aventura emocionante. Unpetrified: Echoes of Nature é uma experiência tranquila e reflexiva, repleta de itens colecionáveis cheios de significado, interações únicas guiadas pelas emoções e quebra-cabeças ambientais. A trilha sonora orquestral realça uma narrativa intimista sobre uma amizade improvável, perda e amor. Last Pirates: Die Together (Game Preview) Last Pirates: Die Together é uma aventura de comédia com modo cooperativo online para até 4 jogadores. Você e sua tripulação usam braços bambos e elásticos para levar o máximo de tesouros possível de volta ao capitão. Este jogo está em desenvolvimento. Ele pode ou não passar por mudanças ao longo do tempo ou ser lançado como um produto final. Compre apenas se você estiver confortável com o estado atual do jogo inacabado. Defina o preço da entrada como quiser: arranque até o último centavo dos clientes ou conquiste a simpatia deles com entrada gratuita. sources.title: Xbox Game Pass recebe 6 novos jogos esta semana! Veja os lançamentos (07)
sources.text: O Xbox Game Pass é um dos serviços de assinatura de games mais democráticos da atualidade, já que é possível acessá-lo de diferentes plataformas — incluindo os próprios, consoles da Microsoft, assim como no PC, nuvem, celulares, tablets e até Smart TVs Samsung e LG com modelos de 2022 para cá. Felizmente, seu catálogo também é atualizado quase que semanalmente, trazendo inúmeras opções para os assinantes aproveitarem — e o melhor de tudo: gastando pouco em comparação às novas tendências de preços da indústria. Se veio em busca de novos jogos para jogar através do Xbox Game Pass , está no lugar certo. O serviço ganhou um reforço de peso esta semana com a chegada de seis títulos para os assinantes aproveitarem. Confira abaixo mais informações sobre as novas aventuras! Em Pit of Goblin os jogadores assumem o papel de goblins que precisam explorar masmorras, escapar de armadilhas e fugir de monstros para alimentar o Rei-Rainha Goblin. O jogo aposta no terror cooperativo online, permitindo formar equipes com amigos ou encarar os desafios sozinho. Mas cuidado: se a missão falhar, você pode acabar virando a próxima refeição! Dos mesmos criadores de Vampire Survivors , Vampire Crawlers: The Turbo Wildcard from Vampire Survivors transforma a fórmula de ação do original em uma aventura de exploração de masmorras em primeira pessoa. Com elementos de roguelite e combate por turnos, o game permite montar baralhos de cartas e criar combinações poderosas para enfrentar inimigos e explorar cenários conhecidos da franquia. Void/Breaker é um FPS roguelite em que os jogadores precisam escapar de um ciclo interminável controlado por uma inteligência artificial hostil. Disponível na versão 1.0 para Xbox Series X|S e Cloud Gaming, o jogo traz combates contra máquinas, além de um sistema de modificações que permite criar diferentes combinações de armas e habilidades. Disponível no lançamento pelo Xbox Game Pass, Escape Academy 2: Back 2 School aposta em uma nova abordagem para os jogos de escape room ao apresentar um mundo aberto repleto de enigmas. A aventura pode ser aproveitada em modo cooperativo local ou online para dois jogadores, que precisam trabalhar juntos para solucionar desafios e escapar das salas. Em Firefighting Simulator: Ignite , os jogadores assumem o papel de bombeiros nos Estados Unidos e precisam enfrentar incêndios, lidar com situações de risco e salvar vidas. O simulador permite formar equipes com até três amigos no modo cooperativo ou contar com personagens controlados pela inteligência artificial para auxiliar nas operações. Por fim, MySims Cozy Bundle reúne versões retrabalhadas de dois jogos da franquia: MySims e MySims Kingdom . Os jogadores podem personalizar uma cidade, explorar um reino de fantasia, fazer amizades e participar de diferentes atividades, incluindo a resolução de quebra-cabeças e a construção e decoração de ambientes. O pacote está disponível nos consoles e no Cloud Gaming. Curtiu as indicações para jogar no Xbox Game Pass? Vale a pena dar uma conferida em Void/Breaker , hein? sources.name: Video Games Chronicle
sources.title: Zelda OOT Remake: Full Bottom of the Well walkthrough
sources.text: Everything you need to get the Lenses of Truth from the Bottom of the Well in The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake If you havenât played The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time before, it will surprise you to learn that Kakariko Villageâs well hides a dark secret. The secret of the Sheikah clan is none of your business, but the Bottom of the Well is a mini-dungeon that hides a valuable item youâll need going forward. In this guide, weâre breaking down just the essential steps to enter and complete the Bottom of the Well mini-dungeon in The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake. If you want all of the optional bonuses inside, be sure to read our Bottom of the Well Gold Skulltula guide . Guides: If you're playing The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time on Nintendo Switch 2, make sure to check our complete walkthrough hub , with guides for Gold Skulltulas locations , empty bottle locations , and how to get the Biggoron Sword . Link can only enter the Bottom of the Well as a child, but in that timeline, the well is filled with water, making it impossible to access. The solution is the Song of Storms. First, visit Kakarikoâs windmill as an adult and present the ocarina to the Music Man. He will teach you the Song of Storms. Now, visit the Music Man in the windmill as a child, and play the Song of Storms for him. This will create a weird time paradox where you are able to teach him the song he taught you. The song will cause a storm, the windmill will speed up, and the well will be drained, allowing Child Link to finally enter. When you get inside, a handy inscription will read âA wall is not merely a wall. Do not accept only what you see as truth.â This is a hint that, well, some walls can be walked straight through. Walls you can walk through appear slightly darker â but watch out, some areas have holes in the floor, too. The first thing you need to do is head to the rear of the area. You can either move through the central room by passing through an illusory wall immediately in front of the player after the first one you use to enter, or you can circle around the square-shape dungeon. Play Zeldaâs Lullaby on the Triforce symbol on the floor to stop the water flow, opening up a new area to crawl into. Head through the crawlspace and through the wallway. Thereâs a hole in front of the small chest â donât worry, youâre supposed to fall in. The Dead Hand is a miniboss that isnât too tough to kill, but itâs not exactly friendly either. It will spawn hands from the ground around the stage that will reach for Link to grab him. Attack the hands to make the main body appear, and then attack its head when it lowers it to deal damage. Be warned, it will try to grab you with the underground hands while the body is overground and attacking, making it tough to defend yourself. Defeating the Dead Hand will give you the Lenses of Truth, a new variation on the classic Lens of Truth item. You can assign this to up on the D-pad instead of a mask, and it will show you which walls are fake, in addition to revealing holes in the ground. Thatâs the main thing you need from this dungeon, but there are still optional things to find, including a Dungeon Map and Compass â but the main missable extras are the Bottom of the Well Gold Skulltulas .

sources.name: GamesRadar
sources.title: Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake devs wanted to nod to the series' notoriously convoluted timeline
sources.text: Developers behind The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time's remake supposedly wanted to nod at the series' infamously twisty, hotly debated and convoluted timeline, but series producer Eiji Aonuma thought it would be better to instead focus purely on making the Switch 2 version the best it could be. Eiji Aonuma said as much in an interview with Game Informer , when asked if The Legend of Zelda canon was ever considered during development. "It's funny because the staff would sometimes ask me about the possibility of including nods to the timeline or references to the other game," he recalls, "and I actually, at the time, would say, 'No, let's focus on this game. Let's make this the best version of Ocarina of Time that we can.'" The Zelda timeline notably diverges into three parallel branches after the events of Ocarina of Time - there's the Fallen Hero timeline (Link to the Past, Link's Awakening), the Child timeline (Majora's Mask and Twilight Princess), and the Adult timeline (Wind Waker, Phantom Hourglass). But Nintendo has never placed too much importance on directly connecting these games one way or another, as series creator Shigeru Miyamoto never thought it was "that important." Breath of the Wild and Tears of the Kingdom's chronological placements have even been left a little ambiguous (they come after every other Zelda story falls into myth, sure, but are potentially set in an entirely separate Hyrule .) Needless to say, debates around the official timeline will likely persist as long as the series is still kicking. "So, the timeline was in the back of our mind, but we didn't consider taking an approach to this game where we actually, explicitly included references like that," Aonuma adds. Things might get even more complicated with more Zelda on the way next year , though Breath of the Wild director Hidemaro Fujibayashi thinks it's important that new Zelda games don't simply re-use older ideas . Nintendo exec says "new games and remakes both have a place" following Zelda: Ocarina of Time launch Sign up to our Switch 2 Spotlight newsletter to make sure you get the very latest news on Nintendo's new console and its games every week Kaan freelances for various websites including Rock Paper Shotgun, Eurogamer, and this one, Gamesradar. He particularly enjoys writing about spooky indies, throwback RPGs, and anything that's vaguely silly. Also has an English Literature and Film Studies degree that he'll soon forget. Not only have many classic puzzles and objectives changed in subtle ways, but there are a fair few brand new challenges and brain teasers to sink your teeth into. If youâre a new player, itâll all be new to you, and while there are more hints than in the original, you might still need a helping hand. In this guide, weâre breaking down everything you need to know about The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time on Nintendo Switch 2 . This guide is being updated regularly, so make sure to bookmark this page and check back for new and updated guides. Ocarina of Timeâs Switch 2 remake now includes a quest menu of sorts called Threads of Time. Here, the gameâs more important main and optional challenges are given more detail. If you need help with a puzzle, weâll have the information you need right here. Sometimes NPCs in Ocarina of Time will hint that an item is required for a specific puzzle without ever telling you how to get it. Here weâre breaking down the important item locations you might need. We have a separate hub breaking down every Gold Skulltula location in OOT Remake. Here’s the contents: Ocarina of Time is filled with a variety of fun minigames, and many of them will reward you with important items or a Piece of Heart. sources.title: Zelda OOT Remake: Win the Treasure Chest Shop game
sources.text: How to win the Treasure Chest Shop game in The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake The Treasure Chest Shop game in The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time is an old classic. If you donât have a certain tool before you go inside the shop, youâre going to make it a lot harder for yourself. It might only cost 10 rupees to enter, but youâll lose most of that money if you donât make the right choices. In this guide, weâre breaking down everything you need to know to win the Treasure Chest Shop game every single time in The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time âs Nintendo Switch 2 remake. Guides: If you're playing The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time on Nintendo Switch 2, make sure to check our complete walkthrough hub , with guides for Gold Skulltulas locations , empty bottle locations , and how to get the Biggoron Sword . The Treasure Chest Shop game isnât rigged; itâs just very difficult to win. Youâll start with a Small Key and a locked door to open. Each room will contain two chests, and you can only open one. One will have another Small Key so you can continue, and the other will have a rupee, which will end the game. Placements are always randomized and are always a true 50/50 chance. The good news is that thereâs a way to win the game every time without any risk. First, you need to earn the Lenses of Truth. To do this, you must complete the Bottom of the Well mini-dungeon . The Lenses of Truth allow you to see the truth. This includes revealing fake walls, hidden holes in the floor, and even seeing the contents of the treasure chests in the Treasure Chest Shop game. Cheeky. Is it cheating? Yes, but you wonât get in trouble for it. Your reward for completing the Treasure Chest Shop game for the first time is a valuable Piece of Heart. You can repeat the game once per night, but successive attempts will only reward you with 20 rupees at best.

sources.title: How to beat the Treasure Chest Game in Zelda Ocarina of Time
sources.text: The Treasure Chest Shop in the OOT Remake can be beaten with luck - or a special item The Treasure Chest Game in the Zelda Ocarina of Time remake has Link forced to pick between a pair of chests five times in a row, with a heart container as the potential reward. If you pick incorrectly at any point you lose, but there is a way (two ways, in fact) to beat the system and get this substantial reward early in the Switch 2 OOT remake. If you want to know how, I'll explain where to find the Treasure Chest Shop in Ocarina of Time, and how to beat the treasure chest game easily. Around the corner, you can find the Zelda Ocarina of Time Happy Mask Shop . Check out our guide on the quest tied to it, and how you can hand out the masks to those who need them! The Treasure Chest Shop in OOT is located on the West Side of Hyrule Castle Town, at the spot shown above. However, it can only be accessed at Night. If it's daytime and you don't want to wait, head North along the alley to the building with the blue door, which will have a bed you can rest in to change the time of day. The Treasure Chest Game is simple: you'll be shown a pair of chests, one of which is right, and one of which is wrong. If you pick correctly, you move forward to the next round. If you pick wrong, you lose the game. If you can pass five rounds, you'll get a heart container. The problem is, the chests looks identical, and each attempt costs you 10 Rupees. sources.title: Sonic Pico Park, Shrek 2 Remastered e mais! Veja os lançamentos de games da semana
sources.text: Mais uma semana que começa com a nossa lista de lançamentos para que você possa se programar para os próximos dias. O grande destaque dessa vez é Sonic Pico Park , game do icônico personagem em uma abordagem nunca antes vista, que mistura elementos de puzzle com cooperação entre os personagens. Outro destaque é Shrek 2 Remastered . Como o nome sugere, ele é uma remasterização de um dos games mais elogiados do famoso ogro dos cinemas, que conta com melhorias nos gráficos e no desempenho. Confira a lista completa de lançamentos da semana e os respectivos preços. Shrek 2 Remastered é uma versão remasterizada do jogo de aventura lançado originalmente para a geração 128 bits , no PlayStation 2 e Nintendo GameCube. O título acompanha o ogro e seus amigos em fases baseadas na história do segundo filme da franquia de animação, passando por locais como o pântano e o reino de Tão Tão Distante. A jogabilidade permite alternar entre quatro personagens durante as missões , cada um com habilidades específicas para resolver puzzles no cenário e avançar na história. O lançamento traz melhorias gráficas e suporte para resolução atualizada, além de manter o foco no modo cooperativo local para até quatro pessoas. O game já está em pré-venda a partir de R$ 87,29. Football Manager 27 é o novo capítulo da franquia anual de simulação e gerenciamento de futebol , que é desenvolvida pela Sports Interactive. O jogador assume o papel de treinador e gerente de um clube, e precisa lidar com as responsabilidades do cargo, d esde a montagem do elenco até o controle das finanças e o relacionamento com a imprensa. A edição deste ano atualiza os elencos, ligas e competições para a temporada atual do futebol mundial. O título oferece ferramentas de análise de dados para ajustar táticas antes e durante as partidas e traz sistemas de observação para contratar novos jogadores e desenvolver talentos nas categorias de base do time. OBS: Por motivos de licenciamento, o jogo não é vendido de forma oficial no Brasil. Warhammer Survivors é um jogo de ação com visão isométrica, inspirado no fenômeno Vampire Survivors. O formato segue o estilo de sobrevivência, no qual os ataques acontecem de forma automática e o foco está na movimentação pelo cenário, enquanto o jogador enfrenta hordas contínuas de inimigos em arenas fechadas. O título reúne mais de 40 campeões extraídos dos universos de Warhammer 40,000 e Warhammer Age of Sigmar. Durante as partidas, é necessário coletar recursos deixados pelos oponentes derrotados para subir de nível e escolher novas armas e habilidades. O game ainda não possui um preço definido, mas já conta com uma versão demo que pode ser baixada de forma gratuita. Sonic Pico Park é um jogo de ação e quebra-cabeça focado no modo multijogador cooperativo. A proposta une os personagens da franquia do ouriço da Sega com as mecânicas de colaboração em grupo vistas no título independente Pico Park original. Para completar cada fase, os participantes precisam coordenar seus movimentos e realizar ações conjuntas, como empilhar os personagens para alcançar locais mais altos ou ativar botões simultaneamente. O progresso exige comunicação constante entre os jogadores , pois falhas individuais resultam no reinício do nível atual. O jogo ainda não possui um preço definido. Barbie Rewind é uma coletânea focada na preservação histórica de títulos antigos da boneca da Mattel, desenvolvida pela Digital Eclipse e publicada pela Atari. O pacote conta com os seguintes jogos: Seguindo o modelo de outros projetos da desenvolvedora, a coleção funciona como um museu virtual interativo, trazendo artes conceituais, documentos de bastidores e materiais de acervo sobre o desenvolvimento dos jogos. O game ainda não possui um preço definido. E na sua opinião, qual o game mais esperado da semana? Conte para a gente nas redes sociais do Voxel! stories.title: Epic Reveals Drop Rate for Fortnite's Pirate Token Following Pressure From Fans
stories.summary: Epic Games has revealed the drop rate for Fortnite's Pirate Token after backlash surrounding the infamous in-game pickup saw fans try to report the studio to the FTC.

sources.name: IGN
sources.title: Epic Reveals Drop Rate for Fortnite's Pirate Token Following Pressure From Fans
sources.text: Epic Games has revealed the drop rate for Fortnite 's Pirate Token after backlash surrounding the infamous in-game pickup saw fans try to report the studio to the FTC. It's been just one week since Epic turned the Item Shop on its head with the launch of its Treasure Hunters mini-season November 1. At the center of the backlash is the Pirate Token, an ultra-rare drop that grants access to the Pirate Shop and effectively makes just about every item in the shop free for 14 days. It's an in-game collectible with unprecedented value, so naturally, it's sent players into a frenzy as they turn over every chest in hopes of finding one for themselves. The problem with a token like this, players have argued, is that they should probably be made aware of the odds of actually finding it so they don't gamble their time on chests that could very likely never yield results. It's transparency that Epic has failed to provide – until now. The developers finally took steps to bring the backlash to an end with a post shared on the Fortnite Service X/Twitter account . Leaving no room for guesswork, Epic spelled out the exact drop rate for this season's treasures and how luck may differ between the average day and Treasure Hours. The one caveat is that Treasure Hours drop rates may be higher in the future, with the team giving the example of a window from tonight that boosts rates for the Pirate Token and Weekly Gold Outfit. You can see the full breakdown below. It's the not-knowing that's been most painful for the thousands of fans who have dedicated hours upon hours looking for the Pirate Token in the last week. Some chose to stick to the grind, opening up chests to no avail. Many, many others, however, took their frustrations online . "All Fortnite players deserve equal treatment," one disgruntled player claimed . "Players who barely play get the Pirate Shop Access Token on day one, while longtime players with 3000+ chests get NOTHING. I'm calling on Fortnite players if we don't get this token, let's BOYCOTT FORTNITE FOREVER." Epic responded to claims that not all Fortnite players have an equal opportunity to find rare items like the Pirate Shop Token in an X post . In addition to saying "buying an account or using fake tools is a scam," it confirmed that, like any other chest in Battle Royale, "every player has an equal opportunity to find Pirate Shop Access." @Pirat_Nation Hey @Pirat_Nation - Buying an account or using fake tools is a scam. This is just like any of the chests in Battle Royale, so every player has an equal opportunity to find Pirate Shop Access. Hello @FTC, Epic Games added a new "Pirate Token" which doesn't have any public odds of getting it, which creates anti-consumer field/FOMO. The game is majorly played by children, they can do anything if they wouldn't get it, so take action against Epic Games please You may not be too surprised to see some calling to boycott Fortnite over the confusion surrounding the Pirate Token. What may be a bit more shocking, though, are those who tried to report Epic to the Federal Trade Commission for failing to share odds out of the gate. "What Fortnite has brought upon this game is predatory and is conducting a deceptive business practice making people believe that everyone has a 'FAIR' chance," another player, who said they "wouldn't be surprised" to see the FTC get involved. "I know people as well where entire squads with over 15,000 chests opened and not getting items simply as the car, jam track, pickaxe, or the loading screen. Fortnite needs to have better transparency with the community and their partners when it comes to hosting events like this." We now know that, during most hours of the day, everyone has a 1:137,000 chance of opening a chest that grants Pirate Shop Access. Before the clarification, players had no idea how many chests they should expect to open before letting frustration set in. A few players online had even surmised that the drop rate could be somewhere around 1:7,000, a far cry from what ended up being the reality. @FortniteStatus "1:137,500 - Pirate Shop Access" That's why Luffy still hasn't found the One Piece after 20 years. https://t.co/eSDpRLYZev Fans are generally happy to see exact odds on their screens, even if they wish Epic had been more transparent at the season's drop. For now, it's unclear if the studio has any plans to try any moves like this again, or if drop rates will be clarified earlier on. "Thank you, this is what we wanted," @StableRonaldo said . "W Fortnite." "Thank you for transparency but it should not have taken a week," @M1das_OW2 replied . Fortnite again found itself in hot water when players launched a campaign against its Nikki from Obsession skin last month. Epic is reportedly working on a Star Wars and Marvel crossover game, though it was reportedly recently delayed . Michael Cripe is a freelance writer with IGN. He's best known for his work at sites like The Pitch, The Escapist, and OnlySP. Be sure to give him a follow on Bluesky (@mikecripe.bsky.social) and Twitter (@MikeCripe).

sources.title: Fortnite officially confirms Pirate Shop Access Token drop rate as players hunt for item which makes entire shop free
sources.text: Epic Games’ odds aren’t necessarily in the player’s favour After much speculation, Epic Games has finally confirmed the exact likelihood of finding the token that grants Pirate Shop Access in Fortnite. Pirate Shop Tokens were added to Fortnite as part of its current mini-season, Fortnite Treasure Hunters, which started on November 1 and is set to end on December 5. The tokens are part of a Treasure Hunt feature, which has been added to the game’s Battle Royale mode. Every time a player opens a chest in the game, there’s a small chance they’ll get a treasure reward. These treasures have different rarities and range from loading screens and jam tracks to one-week-limited vehicles, decals and outfits. The item players are all looking for, however, is the token that provides Pirate Shop Access, because it can offer hundreds of dollars of content. Players who find it receive two tokens â one which can be activated at any point in 2026 between November 1 and December 15, and one which can be activated at any point in 2027 between January 1 and December 31. When a token is activated, every single item in the Fortnite Shop which costs V-Bucks â skins, emotes, backpacks, pickaxes, instruments, cars, gliders, jam tracks and more â becomes entirely free to that player for the next 14 days. Since the token was revealed, players have been frantically trying to find them in chests, with numerous theories on drop rates, a limit on token numbers, and whether the game favours certain types of player. Epic has now officially confirmed the drop rates , however, and it’s now become clear why so few players have been getting the Pirate Shop Access â most of the time, they have a 1 in 137,500 chance of getting one. According to Epic , the likelihood of finding each treasure type is as follows: Occasionally the game will have Treasure Hours, which will last a short period and will boost the drop rates for the Pirate Shop Access by 1.5x. Epic says this may sometimes be higher â during a recent Treasure Hour, Pirate Shop Access was boosted to 2x. The company has previously stressed that the rate does not change depending on the player, so the likelihood doesn’t improve if you’re a new or returning player.

sources.text: Bandai Namco has released a teaser trailer for My Hero Ultra Rumble Mobile , its newly announced mobile version of the free-to-play battle royale coming. Pre-registration is available now for iOS via App Store and Android via Google Play . As previously detailed, the mobile version will operate as its own game, and will not support cross-play between the existing console and PC versions of My Hero Ultra Rumble . Cross-play between iOS and Android is supported. Here is an overview of the game, via its store pages: My Hero Ultra Rumble Mobile is finally here! Become your favorite My Hero Academia characters and fight to survive in an epic battle royale featuring eight teams of three players! Use your Quirks to team up with players online and fight your way to become the last team standing! An online multiplayer action game where you battle as My Hero Academia characters in an epic 24-player battle royale! Take on a vast battlefield and unleash each character’s unique Quirk! Team up with players online and fight your way to becoming the last team standing! Every new season will add content, including characters and costumes! Dive into a battle where the tide can turn in an instant! Watch the trailer below. Visit the official website here .

stories.title: Insane GTA 6 Takeover Arrives in London’s Selfridges Store
stories.summary: In London, an incredible GTA 6-themed takeover has happened in Selfridges, one of the most iconic department stores in the world. The post Insane GTA 6 Takeover Arrives in London’s Selfridges Store appeared first on Insider Gaming .

sources.name: Insider Gaming
sources.title: Insane GTA 6 Takeover Arrives in London’s Selfridges Store
sources.text: Folks were wondering when the Grand Theft Auto 6 marketing hype would hit the United Kingdom, and it’s safe to say it has finally arrived. In London’s Selfridges store, located on the iconic Oxford Street, a full-scale GTA 6 takeover has popped up, with the storefront being absolutely transformed in recognition of the imminent release of Rockstar’s next epic. The store is poised to sell fans of the franchise some of the hottest GTA 6 merchandise around, most of which has never been seen before. In the store, there’s even a classic Ferrari decked out in GTA 6 colors, which was reportedly flown in from Miami for the takeover. In a series of images and videos uploaded across social media, fans of Rockstar’s open-world crime-action series are getting a look at what has landed in Oxford Street in London this morning. Selfridges, one of the most recognizable stores in the nation and an establishment with more than 100 years in the history books, has received a Grand Theft Auto-themed rebrand for the foreseeable future, all in tribute to the imminent launch of the highly anticipated game. It’s a complete overhaul of the store. As you can see in the images on social media, Rockstar Games has flown in supercars, massive statues, neon lights, and all kinds of merchandise to be sold in the run-up to release. Online, the Selfridges store was brought to an absolute standstill as close to 100,000 people joined a queue to start buying said merchandise, which consists of t-shirts, bags, towels, hats, hoodies, mugs, keychains, and much more. UPDATE: As of 09:40 GMT, almost all of the exclusive merchandise is already out of stock at Selfridges. Are you going to head into London to pick up some GTA 6 merch from Selfridges? Let us know your plans on the Insider Gaming Discord server . For more Insider Gaming coverage, check out the news that GTA 6 will have 55 Trophies/Achievem e nts , also, don’t forget to sign up for our weekly newsletter Grant has been gaming for 30+ years and in the industry for 10+. You'll probably find him playing a post-apocalyptic game or an extraction shooter somewhere.
